name: SSRN (web)
description: SSRN's preprint and working-paper library in the social sciences, economics, law and health.
terms: Manual. SSRN blocks automated clients and has no public search API. Key writes the search and opens SSRN in its browser. SSRN papers have DOIs (10.2139/ssrn.NNNN): the SSRN via Crossref connector finds them by title, without abstracts.

steps: Key opens SSRN's search with your words. SSRN reads title, abstract and keywords; if it refuses brackets, search one part of your search at a time.
Sort by date or relevance and open the papers you want.
SSRN has no export of a result list. Add papers by their DOI (on each paper's page) or collect them in SSRN's 'My Library' and copy the DOIs.
Write down the number of hits and the date for your search log.
manual.importHint: Paste the SSRN DOIs (10.2139/ssrn....) into Key's Add by identifier; Key fetches the details.

guide.summary: SSRN holds working papers and preprints in economics, finance, law and the social sciences, often long before publication. Key cannot search SSRN itself, so it opens it for you.
guide.fields: SSRN's search reads title, abstract and keywords.
limits: The SSRN via Crossref connector reaches SSRN papers by title automatically, but without abstracts.
guide.credentials: A free SSRN account is needed to download some papers.
